def make_run(text, ins=False):
    r = etree.SubElement(None if False else etree.Element(q('r')), 'x')  # placeholder
    return r

def new_run(text):
    r = etree.Element(q('r'))
    t = etree.SubElement(r, q('t'))
    t.set('{http://www.w3.org/XML/1998/namespace}space', 'preserve')
    t.text = text
    return r

def split_run(run, before, target, after):
    """Replace run in-place with [before-run, del-wrap(target), ins-wrap(new), after-run].
    Returns (del_el, ins_el) or None if target not found."""
    t = run.find(q('t'))
    txt = t.text or ''
    i = txt.find(target)
    if i < 0:
        return None
    before_t, after_t = txt[:i], txt[i+len(target):]
    parent = run.getparent()
    idx = parent.index(run)
    new_els = []
    if before_t:
        new_els.append(new_run(before_t))
    dele = etree.Element(q('del'))
    dele.set(q('id'), nextid()); dele.set(q('author'), AUTHOR); dele.set(q('date'), DATE)
    dr = etree.Element(q('r'))
    dt = etree.SubElement(dr, q('delText'))
    dt.set('{http://www.w3.org/XML/1998/namespace}space', 'preserve')
    dt.text = target
    dele.append(dr)
    new_els.append(dele)
    return new_els, after_t, parent, idx, run

def apply_replace(para, target, repl):
    """Find run containing target, split, wrap deletion and insertion."""
    for run in para.iter(q('r')):
        t = run.find(q('t'))
        if t is not None and t.text and target in t.text:

            dt = etree.SubElement(dr, q('delText'))
            dt.set('{http://www.w3.org/XML/1998/namespace}space', 'preserve')
            dt.text = target
            dele.append(dr)
            new_els.append(dele)
            ins = etree.Element(q('ins'))
            ins.set(q('id'), nextid()); ins.set(q('author'), AUTHOR); ins.set(q('date'), DATE)
            ins.append(new_run(repl))
            new_els.append(ins)
            if after_t:
                new_els.append(new_run(after_t))
            parent.remove(run)

            return True

    ref_r = etree.Element(q('r'))
    ref = etree.SubElement(ref_r, q('commentReference'))
    ref.set(q('id'), cid)
    ce.addnext(ref_r)
    c = etree.SubElement(comments_root, q('comment'))

RNS = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships'
rel = etree.SubElement(rels, '{%s}Relationship' % RNS)
rel.set('Id', 'rIdComments900')
rel.set('Type', 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/comments')
rel.set('Target', 'comments.xml')

new_doc = etree.tostring(doc, xml_declaration=True, encoding='UTF-8', standalone=True)
new_rels = etree.tostring(rels, xml_declaration=True, encoding='UTF-8', standalone=True)
new_ct = etree.tostring(ct, xml_declaration=True, encoding='UTF-8', standalone=True)

zout = zipfile.ZipFile(DST, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED)
for item in zin.infolist():
    data = zin.read(item.filename)
    if item.filename == 'word/document.xml':

    elif item.filename == '[Content_Types].xml':
